prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Thank you for an amazing trip. Arrivedercia a Roma! https://t.co/gNmkj9CzBf
Delta: Happy to hear you had an amazing trip! Thanks for trusting us. 😊 *AMV

Customer: how can I arrange a shuttle from one gate to another for a connecting flight for an elderly person?
Delta: The information will be place in the reservation.  The wheelchair can be requested at curbside upon arrival.   *HML

Customer: so disappointed flight #4057 from    is delayed. Now I'm 7 hours behind after missing 2 connecting flights  to SanFrancisco airport
Delta: Please reach out to us via this link to discuss compensation options: *HKC https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: Thank you  for this amazing view departing #PuertoRico ❤️ https://t.co/K0piFO0vpL
Delta: Wow, what an amazing view. Thanks for sharing this shot with us, I love it! #DeltaProud ✈ *AST

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: praise):
"""agents even walked person to person to discuss their connecting flights. Thank you and amazing team effort"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re thrilled our team could help you personally with your connections—thank you for the kind words! ✈️😊
